feedback: The geometry provides a good balanced baseline with moderate size and mass, which should help the controller maintain stability and traction. The five sensors spaced evenly near the front center give good line detection coverage, allowing the controller to detect line position early and steer smoothly. The medium sensor size (0.012) balances sensitivity and noise robustness well. The wheel radius and track are moderate, supporting good maneuverability and ground contact. Overall, this geometry is well suited for a stable, general-purpose controller and should not require major compensations at this stage.
requested_changes: Increase sensor_count to 7 to improve line detection resolution and allow finer steering control.
Try sensor_size 0.016 to increase sensor sensitivity and improve line detection robustness, especially in curves.
Slightly increase wheel_track to 0.15 to enhance turning stability and reduce wheel slip during maneuvers.
